caption:
Comment EBOOK and I'll send you the full Faceless AI Affiliate ebook. 🔒

Ten offers isn't a plan. It's quitting, spread across ten tabs.

The first offer hasn't worked yet. Starting a second one feels like progress, and it costs you nothing to feel that. But it's the same first week again.

The rule: one offer, one format, until it works. You can't learn anything from three tests running at once.

Add a second only when all three are true:

1. The first one converts. Not just views — comments turning into sign-ups.
2. You can run it without thinking. A week of posts in one sitting.
3. You have 90 days of data. Less than that is noise.

Comment EBOOK for the whole thing in order.
